subject: general
question: In which state is Vijay Stambh situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijay Stambh** is situated in **Chittorgarh, Rajasthan**.
 
• It is also known as the **Victory Tower**.
 
• The tower was constructed by Rana Kumb
